# dowel

> One binary for your Flutter dev loop and your AI agent: start, hot reload and inspect a running app, scaffold code, install plugins transactionally, and expose the same commands through a built-in stdio MCP server.

**Stack**: Dart >=3.4. dowel is pure Dart; the app you drive needs Flutter.

**Setup**:

```bash
dart pub add dowel
dart run dowel install     # bin/dispatcher.dart, lib/app/*.g.dart barrels, bin/dowel fast wrapper
dart run dowel list        # every registered command
```

```dart
import 'package:dowel/dowel.dart';

final class GreetCommand extends DowelCommand {
  @override
  String get signature => 'greet {name} {--shout}';

  @override
  String get description => 'Greet a person by name.';

  @override
  CommandBoot get boot => CommandBoot.none;

  @override
  Future<int> handle(DowelContext context) async {
    context.output.success('Hello, ${context.input.argument('name') ?? 'world'}');
    return 0;
  }
}
```

## API

- `runDowel(args, baseProviders:, autoProviders:)`: the shared entry; delegates to the project's `bin/dispatcher.dart` when it has one.
- `DowelCommand`: `signature` (`'cmd:name {arg} {--flag}'`) or `configure(ArgParser)`; `handle(DowelContext)` returns the exit code.
- `DowelServiceProvider`: `commands()` and `mcpTools()`; a plugin exports one from `package:<name>/cli.dart`.
- `DowelInstallCommand` and `PluginInstaller`: staged install operations (file writes swap in through `.tmp` files, but helper edits write directly and neither they nor a failure during the swap are rolled back) that `plugin:uninstall` can reverse; `install.yaml` is the declarative form.

## Built-in commands

Run as `dart run dowel <cmd>` (or `./bin/dowel <cmd>` once `install` built it).

- Run the app (also MCP tools): `start`, `stop`, `status`, `logs`, `restart`, `reload`, `hot-restart`, `tinker`.
- Inspect (also MCP tools): `doctor`, `list`.
- Scaffold: `install`, `make:plugin`, `make:command`, `make:fast-cli`.
- Plugins: `plugin:install`, `plugin:uninstall`, `plugins:refresh`, `commands:refresh`.
- MCP wiring: `mcp:serve`, `mcp:install`, `mcp:uninstall`.
- `help`.

The commands marked "also MCP tools" are the substrate tools, named `dowel_<command>` with `:` and `-` turned into `_` (`dowel_hot_restart`). The rest write source, prompt or recurse into the server, so they are CLI-only: run them from a shell.

## Platforms

The lifecycle commands (`start`, `stop`, `reload`, `hot-restart`) use a POSIX FIFO: macOS and Linux. The rest of the CLI and the MCP server run wherever Dart does.

## Rules for agents

- Start the app with `dowel start`, not `flutter run`: reload, restart, logs and tinker find it through the session recorded under `~/.dowel/sessions/<hash>/`.
- In a git worktree, run `dowel start` there (or pass `--state=<path>`) before any command that uses the session (`reload`, `stop`, `tinker`, a plugin's `<package>:*`). The ownership check passes when the worktree sits inside the project root the main app recorded (an app at the repo root, the worktree under it) and for state with no recorded `projectRoot`; the command then acts on the main app and reports success. A sibling checkout, or an app in a subdirectory the worktree is not inside, is refused. MCP plugin tools and `dowel_tinker` run no such check, and MCP tools always act on the project the server started in, so run these commands from a shell inside the worktree.
- Read the app log from the file named by the `log=` line of `dowel start`, or with `./bin/dowel logs`: `dowel_logs` over MCP writes to the server's stdout, which is the transport, and does not return it.
- Run `dart run dowel install` once before `plugin:install` for a plugin without an `install.yaml`; it creates the scaffold the plugin is registered into (`lib/app/_plugins.g.dart`).
- Preview with `plugin:install <name> --dry-run`; it writes nothing. A real run can leave helper edits behind if it fails, so check `git status` after a failure.
- Do not edit `*.g.dart` barrels; regenerate them with `commands:refresh` and `plugins:refresh`.
- Plugin MCP tools need `./bin/dowel mcp:serve` or `dart run :dispatcher mcp:serve`; `dart run dowel:mcp` serves the substrate tools only.
- Reconnect the MCP client after `mcp:install` or a change to `.dowel/mcp.json`; stdio servers are not reloaded on their own.
- Exit code `75` means "not ready, retry" (the app is still building); any other non-zero code is a failure.
- The only project wrapper is `bin/dispatcher.dart`; `bin/dowel.dart` is this package's own entry point and is ignored as one.

## Docs

- [Getting started](https://anilcancakir.com/dowel/docs/getting-started/index.md): what dowel is and how the pieces fit
- [Installation](https://anilcancakir.com/dowel/docs/getting-started/installation.md): requirements and `dart pub add dowel`
- [Quickstart](https://anilcancakir.com/dowel/docs/getting-started/quickstart.md): from an empty project to a plugin and a command
- [Commands](https://anilcancakir.com/dowel/docs/commands/index.md): the catalogue, grouped by intent, with boot mode and MCP exposure
- [install](https://anilcancakir.com/dowel/docs/commands/install.md): the consumer scaffold
- [make:fast-cli](https://anilcancakir.com/dowel/docs/commands/make-fast-cli.md): the AOT wrapper `bin/dowel`
- [make:plugin](https://anilcancakir.com/dowel/docs/commands/make-plugin.md): scaffold a plugin package
- [mcp:serve](https://anilcancakir.com/dowel/docs/commands/mcp-serve.md): the stdio server and its filter
- [plugin:install](https://anilcancakir.com/dowel/docs/commands/plugin-install.md): the manifest route and direct registration
- [start](https://anilcancakir.com/dowel/docs/commands/start.md): the recorded session, one per project (`--state=<path>` or `DOWEL_STATE_FILE` overrides it)
- [tinker](https://anilcancakir.com/dowel/docs/commands/tinker.md): evaluate Dart in the running app
- [MCP overview](https://anilcancakir.com/dowel/docs/mcp/overview.md): substrate and plugin tools, the state file contract
- [MCP setup](https://anilcancakir.com/dowel/docs/mcp/setup.md): wire the server into Claude Code, Cursor and others
- [MCP tool reference](https://anilcancakir.com/dowel/docs/mcp/tool-reference.md): every substrate tool and its input
- [Plugin authoring](https://anilcancakir.com/dowel/docs/plugins/authoring.md): write a plugin
- [install.yaml schema](https://anilcancakir.com/dowel/docs/plugins/install-yaml.md): every section and key
- [Installer DSL](https://anilcancakir.com/dowel/docs/plugins/installer-dsl.md): the procedural escape hatch
- [Signature DSL](https://anilcancakir.com/dowel/docs/reference/signature-dsl.md): the argument and flag grammar
